candidate_cases: A: The environmental descriptor can support a broad environmental-protection reading, and no narrower environmental concern is explicit. B: The descriptor may be only a name or aspiration, while the title does not identify the expedition's purpose, action, or governed subject.
arbitration_rationale: Option B is better supported: the title names an expedition but does not say what the formal output concerns, so the protocol's abstention rule applies rather than forcing a broad environmental label from an ambiguous descriptor.
